4、Always warm up before and cool down after exercise to allow gradual cardiovascular adjustment.
5、Stay hydrated and avoid caffeine or stimulants close to exercise sessions.

7、If taking anticoagulants, avoid activities with high risk of falls or impact injuries.
8、Gradually increase exercise intensity and duration to assess tolerance.
9、Listen to your body and do not push beyond your comfort or symptom threshold.
